From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Sent: Saturday, December 20, 2014 3:55 PM
To: Richard Verlander <theverlanders@aol.com>
Subject: Re: Justin off-season story 
 
Thanks for the quick response. Absolutely I will talk to them and see if anything comes of it.

Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Richard Verlander <theverlanders@aol.com>
Sent: Friday, December 19, 2014 5:54 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: Re: Justin off-season story 
 
Hi Anthony, 
  Jo-Ann did some nice work with us, but it was a story about our family, our book or something we were involved in as parents. Kathy and I are happy to talk w you but any interviews w Justin should go through normal channels w the Tigers. Happy Holidays.
                                                                                                                                                                        Richard
On Dec 19, 2014, at 4:20 PM, "Fenech, Anthony" <afenech@freepress.com> wrote:
My name is Anthony Fenech and I’m the new Tigers beat writer for the Free Press.
I got your e-mail address from Jo-Ann Barnas.

I’m writing to see if you could reach out to Justin and see if he would consider letting me spend some time with him this winter and sit in on a workout or bullpen to write a behind-the-scenes kind of story.
His story is an important one to this year’s Tigers team and I’d like to share it with our readers.
Look forward to hearing from you.

Anthony Fenech 
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
c: 734-752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
